title: Delete templates/env/retired/ and the env writer's retire check: every sleeve has moved onto the env liberator (cc's hold 16)
body:
## What

`lib/env.sh` keeps the files the claude liberator published `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` through before the env liberator took them over, as templates under `templates/env/retired/`: `com.molt.claude-config-dir.plist.tmpl` for macOS and `claude.conf.tmpl` for Linux. They are kept only so that a retired file that is still what molt rendered can be told from one somebody changed: check names one still there, and install removes it, or refuses one that was changed. Its own comment says they "go once every sleeve has moved".

cc held the deletion (cc's hold 16) until gyges resleeved onto the env liberator. molt-vc released it on 4 Nov 2026: env's check fails while either retired file remains (`molt_env_report_faults`), and doctor passes with env enabled on rhadamanth, gyges and kovacs, so neither file is left on any of them; farcaster and pihole run neither claude nor env. molt-vc, 4 Nov: build the deletion into 1.4.3, with molt-dc building it since cc is paused.

## Next

1. Remove `templates/env/retired/`, `_molt_env_retired`, `_molt_env_retired_state`, the retired loop in `molt_env_report_faults`, `_molt_env_retire` and its call in `molt_env_publish`, and the comments that name them. `molt_env_published` stays, for its callers in `liberators/claude.sh`.
2. The tests of the retired files go with them, `intent/llm/MODULES.md` loses the retired templates' row, and the CHANGELOG line goes under `## [1.4.3] - unreleased`.
3. Proof: nothing in Molt's code, tests or live docs names the retired files or functions after the change, and env.bats and claude.bats pass under both bashes in a slot pplr-vc grants. dc builds it on its own branch in `$TMPDIR/molt-wt/`, and molt-vc merges.

## As built

molt-dc, 4 Nov 2026, on `dc/0091-env-retired` from main at 327ec0c, one commit, 7a42b59. molt-vc reviewed it, passed it with no change asked, and merged it on main at ed39f72, once the merged tree of 0088, 0091 and 0089, at cacef76, passed the whole suite in slot 01M6KZK8, which pplr-vc granted, 19:13Z to 19:26Z: 648 of 648 under bash 5.3.20 and under /bin/bash 3.2.57, with ShellCheck clean on 42 scripts.

1. Gone from `lib/env.sh`: `_molt_env_retired`, `_molt_env_retired_state`, the retired loop in `molt_env_report_faults` and its comment, and `_molt_env_retire` with its call in `molt_env_publish`. `templates/env/retired/` goes with both its templates. `molt_env_published` stays, for its callers in `liberators/claude.sh`.
2. `test/liberators/env.bats` loses its two tests of the old plist and `claude.conf`, `intent/llm/MODULES.md` the retired templates' row, `docs/guides/sleeve-agents.md` its two doctor rows and its replace-and-remove sentences, and the README's layout its `env/retired/` clause.

Proof, in slot 01M6KSJW84T9K7FMB147R5VA41, which pplr-vc granted, 17:27Z to 17:32Z: env.bats and claude.bats whole, 80 of 80 under bash 5.3.20 and under /bin/bash 3.2.57, main's 82 less the two this deletes. No test is new, since it is a deletion: the proof is that nothing in `lib`, `liberators`, `templates`, `test`, `docs`, the README, `intent/llm`, `usage-rules.md` or `bin/molt` names a retired file or function, and molt-vc found none outside `intent/` and the CHANGELOG on the merged tree. ShellCheck -x and `bash -n` under both bashes are clean on `lib/env.sh`, and so are the intent critic gate and prettier. critic-shell was not run: a deletion adds no code for it to judge.
